name: Chakra Bolt
description: A compressed pellet of raw chakra. The first technique every academy student learns.

name: Focus Seal
description: Steadies the chakra network, sharpening every strike and technique for a short time.

name: Mending Palm
description: Floods your own wounds with chakra to knit them closed.

name: Five-Nature Seal
description: The sealing technique of the scroll's makers: all five natures woven into one binding circle. Crushing on anything inside it, and costly.

name: Shade Clones
description: Chakra doubles step out of your shadow in your own likeness and fight at your side until they fade or are struck down. Casting again replaces them.
